description: CompassOne from the terminal: tenants, detections, assets, vulnerabilities, posture, reports and Cloud Response admin, plus a cross-tenant fleet view of open detections, stale agents and coverage gaps.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant detection queue
novel_features.description: One oldest-first queue of open detections across every customer tenant, with tenant name, age, alert count and ticket status. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: Client report bundle
novel_features.description: Live: build one client's reporting-window summary from six CompassOne endpoints (posture, detection count and weekly trend, top entities and threats, latest report run per type). Needs BLACKPOINT_API_TOKEN; failed sections are listed under fetch_failures.

novel_features.name: Coverage gaps
novel_features.description: Find tenants with no recent completed scan, no or empty escalation contact group, or no posture rating; scans_unknown, contacts_unknown or posture_unknown means that data could not be fetched. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: Stale agents
novel_features.description: List devices across every tenant whose agent has not reported in N days or never checked in, with Defender status; decommissioned devices are skipped unless --include-decommissioned. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: CVE spread
novel_features.description: Rank unresolved CVEs by how many tenants and assets they affect; --exploited or --prioritized narrows the list. Needs the vulnerability-management entitlement: when every tenant's fetch was refused (403) it fails instead of returning an empty list. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: Tenant overview
novel_features.description: One offline current-state view of a tenant: open detections, stale devices, exploited or prioritized CVEs, last scans, posture, dark-web exposure counts, cloud connection state and escalation contacts. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; an unknown tenant or a store with no fleet data exits 3 (not found).

novel_features.name: Posture leaderboard
novel_features.description: Rank tenants by security posture score as a share of their maximum, with maturity level and weakest NIST function. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: Geo policy audit
novel_features.description: Audit Cloud Response approved countries per connection and per user; flag expired or expiring travel exceptions and broad allow-lists. Reads the local store, so run fleet-sync first; before that it returns an empty list with a stderr hint.

novel_features.name: Fleet sync
novel_features.description: Pull every tenant's detections, devices, vulnerabilities, scans, exposures, posture, contact groups and approved countries into the local store; failed or incomplete fetches are kept, reported under fetch_failures, and flagged by the readers.
